title: Set up the @galvor.ai profile for B2B
why: Instagram has no plan yet; the profile is the landing page for every post.
how: Name field: 'Galvor | Creative Intelligence'. Bio: 'Know why your ads win. Decoding D2C ads, every two weeks. Free category decode ↓'. Category: Software. Switch to a Business account (needed for Insights and the API).

title: Link-in-bio page with UTM links
why: Instagram captions can't link; every 'link in bio' needs a destination you can measure.
how: One page (e.g. galvor.ai/links): Decoded archive, free category decode, brief template, book a call. UTM: ?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=<post id>.

title: Story highlights
why: Highlights are the permanent menu for new visitors.
how: Decoded · Teardowns · Proof · Team · Ask us. Render covers in the studio theme (story size, festival or cover layout).

title: Reels production kit and a batching day
why: Reels need faces and B-roll; without a routine they're the first thing to slip.
how: Phone + clip-on mic + ring light. Film 4 reels every alternate Thursday afternoon from the scripts in the studio. Use Instagram's licensed audio only.

title: Cross-post reels to YouTube Shorts (@galvor.ai)
why: The YouTube channel exists but isn't in any plan; Shorts reuse costs nothing.
how: Upload each reel to Shorts the same day with the same caption.

title: Employee and founder advocacy rota
why: Personal profiles drive most reach (plan, Review 3); the first hour decides distribution.
how: Each author pings the team when a post goes live; 3 real comments inside 60 minutes. KC: 3–5 comments + 1 reshare a week.

title: LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads on the best founder post each month
why: Boosting a proven organic post is the cheapest paid reach to exact job titles.
how: Small monthly test aimed at D2C founders, CMOs and growth heads in India; boost only posts beating the median by 2×.

title: Collab posts with clients and creators
why: Instagram Collab posts and co-authored LinkedIn posts reach both audiences.
how: Only with written permission; start with creator campaigns Shrutik runs.

title: Subscribe CTA on every Decoded promo
why: Newsletter subscribers are owned reach — notified of every issue.
how: First comment + last slide: 'Subscribe to Decoded'.

title: Lead magnets that match the soft asks
why: Posts promise a one-page brief template and a free category decode; both must exist before those posts go out.
how: Brief template as a PDF in the studio theme + a 'Get a free category decode' form on galvor.ai with a 'Where did you hear about us?' field.

title: UTM convention for every link
why: Without UTMs, LinkedIn and Instagram traffic is invisible in analytics.
how: utm_source=linkedin|instagram · utm_medium=social · utm_campaign=<studio post id> · utm_content=<voice>.

title: 'How did you first hear of Galvor?' field in the sales pipeline
why: Day 90 is judged on pipeline, not likes (plan, Review 4).
how: Required field in the Galvor CRM; Sunil and KC ask it on every first call.

title: Saved replies and a DM playbook
why: Fast, consistent replies to 'decode', 'brief' and pricing DMs.
how: Three saved replies per platform; reply within 2 business hours.

title: Written permission from 2 clients for named case studies
why: January's theme is proof; without permission the stories stay anonymous and thinner.
how: Ask in November; offer a co-branded carousel and a newsletter feature.

title: Three client video testimonials (30–45 s)
why: Faces plus results are the highest-trust content on both platforms.
how: Shrutik records after a successful cycle. Three questions: before, what changed, what you'd tell a peer.

title: Second admin on every account
why: 86% of page posts came from one admin (metrics file) — a single point of failure.
how: 2+ super admins on the LinkedIn page; 2 people with Instagram access via Meta Business Suite.

title: Negative comment and crisis policy
why: A plan for criticism, spam and competitor jabs avoids rushed replies.
how: Reply once with facts, move details to DM, never delete criticism (hide only spam/abuse), escalate to Sunil.

title: Claims and permissions check before approval
why: No client names, no competitor spend claims, every number sourced — the studio's checks enforce most of it.
how: Approver reviews the Quality check panel; Sunil approves anything that names a client or makes a claim.

title: Monday 15-minute metrics ritual
why: The weekly tracker only works if someone fills it in.
how: Every Monday after the huddle: add the week on Analytics and enter 7-day results on last week's posts.

title: Monthly competitor social review
why: Know what other ad-intelligence and martech brands post and what lands.
how: Last Friday of the month: 30 minutes, 5 accounts, note 3 formats or angles to test.

title: Pick 2027 events (Goafest, D2C summits, SaaSBoomi)
why: In-person events give the best content and the warmest leads; dates are still TBC in the key-dates calendar.
how: Decide by January; plan before/during/after posts for each.

title: A founder podcast or LinkedIn Live once a quarter
why: Long-form conversation builds authority faster than posts alone.
how: Sunil plus a client or operator; cut into 5 clips for both platforms.

title: Tagline: Know why your ads win. Creative Marketing Intelligence Platform that learns your brand.

title:
About / Overview: Media got optimized to the decimal. The content running through it didn't.

Galvor is the creative marketing intelligence platform for D2C performance teams. We explain why an ad worked or failed — then use that evidence to plan and produce the next one.

→ Decode: every ad tagged across 50+ attributes and priced by CPO or CAC. We price the attribute, not the ad.
→ Brand Memory: creatives, briefs, feedback and learnings in one place.
→ Create: Vira turns winning formulas into scripts, cuts and finished ads.
→ Ask Galvor: plain-English answers from your data, returned as a brief.
→ Run: managed Decode → Prove → Create → Ship loop every 14 days.

Published scoring method · never touches your media budget · human approval on every action.
Client-reported: +67% RoAS fashion, +112% beauty, +91% wellness.
Best fit: D2C brands spending $50K+/month (₹40L+) on paid social, 20+ creatives/month.
→ galvor.ai
why: Now: Built around the '4Cs' (Creative, Creator, Contributor, Competitor), 2.4M+ signals per brand, 40%→90% prediction accuracy, RoAS results. LinkedIn and galvor.ai currently describe different products; visitors who click through get confused
